semantics: What the Reaction Explorer can answer through the existing ReactionMatcher. MODELED_REACTION, MODELED_NO_REACTION and NOT_MODELED are separate; NOT_MODELED is never shown as "no reaction".

matcher.phase: the canonical species' own phase (never guessed)
matcher.conditions: only what the learner states; unknown values are refused

reachability.definition: opening the generated deep link reproduces this exact record through ReactionMatcher (reactants resolved AND every required condition stated faithfully)

conditionContract.explorerSupportedAs: condition-vocabulary dimensions (the learner states dimension values; nothing unstated is assumed)
conditionContract.rule: a record that requires an unsupported field is EXPLORER_CONDITION_UNSUPPORTED: no deep link, not reachable, no search entry; the explorer shows "not yet supported", never a condition to choose
conditionContract.note: today every record uses only tag conditions; this is a property of the current data, not a claim that every condition type is supported

pairsOfCanonicalSpecies.note: counts the records written for a pair (any conditions); NOT_MODELED pairs are unknown, not non-reacting

ionicEquation.rule: shown only when IonicEngine.support(reactionId) is supported:true; never a fallback
